decided: When a signed program has a newer brief and the program pull request may still be marked ready, the architecture session skips the new question only when the pull request check positively shows nothing is left to mark ready: the pull request is ready, none is open, none was ever recorded, or the recorded one is no longer the program's open pull request (closed, merged, pointed at another branch, or from another repository) and no open replacement exists. When the check fails, cannot reach GitHub, finds several candidate pull requests, or reports a draft, the user is asked again.
alternatives: ask again only on a draft or unverified state, which skips the question when the check fails with no recorded link or finds several candidates
why: A question that holds the ready step should never be skipped because the state could not be read; skipping it is only safe when the state is known.

relies_on.title: `orbit pr program` computes the architect readout's PR facts
